prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1154; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological screening at initial evaluation showed mild impairment in balance and visual tracking, with no focal deficits. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical decision rules. The patient was diagnosed with concussion and advised on cognitive and physical rest, with a gradual return-to-activity protocol.

Over the course of 18 visits, the patient was seen for vestibular and oculomotor rehabilitation, with progressive exercises targeting gaze stability, balance, and exertional tolerance. Symptoms improved steadily, and headache frequency and light sensitivity decreased. Cognitive complaints resolved more slowly and required workplace accommodations for a period of time. At the most recent evaluation, the patient had largely returned to baseline function, with residual mild fatigue during prolonged screen use. Ongoing home exercise and graded activity were recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
